title: Ballet Lesson
hook: 佩奇第一次上芭蕾课，回家后当小老师教全家人跳，猪爸爸跳得摔了一跤。

cells.a: She is going to her first ballet lesson.
cells.cn: 她要去上第一堂芭蕾课。

cells.q: What did Madame Gazelle say to Peppa?
cells.a: She said, “Welcome to your first lesson of the ballet!”
cells.cn: 她说：“欢迎来上你的第一堂芭蕾课！”

cells.q: Who is the new pupil in the class?
cells.a: Peppa Pig is the new pupil in the ballet class.
cells.cn: 佩奇是芭蕾班里的新同学。

cells.a: Yes, the ballet lesson is a lot of fun.

cells.q: What did Madame Gazelle ask about swans?
cells.a: She asked what noise a swan might make.
cells.cn: 她问天鹅会发出什么声音。

cells.q: What did Peppa want to show her family?
cells.a: She wanted to show them how she did ballet.
cells.cn: 她想给家人看她怎么跳芭蕾。

cells.q: What did Peppa teach her family?
cells.a: She taught them how to do ballet in the living room.
cells.cn: 她在客厅教大家怎么跳芭蕾。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig tell Daddy Pig?
cells.a: She told him to be careful when he tried ballet.
cells.cn: 她让猪爸爸跳的时候小心点。

cells.t: That Wasn't How I Remembered It
cells.a: He fell down and said it was not how he remembered it.
cells.cn: 他摔了一跤，说这不是他记得的样子。
